determination.question: What authority does the GATE22 functional BUILD require?

referenceSequence.note: first ledger event after the BUILD

evidence.conclusion: No ledger event and no additional authority artifact exists between GATE21 CONTRACT_SUCCESSION and AGENT_CLOSURE, so the functional BUILD itself consumes no lifecycle authority.

sufficientAuthority.scope: EXECUTION_CONTRACT_R0002.authorizedPaths, restricted to the buildWritePaths subset

requiredAuthorityForBuild.additionalGovernanceBoundary: Owner mission authorization is a governance boundary observed in the mission, not a cryptographic artifact to produce.

nextAuthorityAfterBuild.reason: Closure authority is issued after the BUILD produces its evidence, never before.

precontractConsumptionAnchor.requiredForContractSuccessionProof: validate-status-ledger validateContractSuccession() reads only documentKind, gateId, authorityMode, maxUse, predecessor/successor contract bytes and the state pin; it never consults the precontract anchor. The only consumers of evaluatePrecontractAnchorEnforcement are final-gate-integrity-auditor.mjs and gate-fast-path-control-plane.mjs.
precontractConsumptionAnchor.appendableNowProof: PRECONTRACT_CONSUMPTION_ANCHOR_TRANSITIONS admits only NOT_STARTED->NOT_STARTED and COMPLETE_AGENT->COMPLETE_AGENT. GATE22 is IN_PROGRESS, so the transition table forbids the event at this point in the lifecycle.
precontractConsumptionAnchor.nextLegalWindow: COMPLETE_AGENT -> COMPLETE_AGENT, after AGENT_CLOSURE and before the final integrity audit
